name: isotox-regonly
comment: THE REGULAR-ONLY SUBTREE OF A SINGLE-STAR ISOTOXAL PALETTE, as its own palette. Under the min-type-root rule a configuration never uses a vertex type below its root, so if the alphabet is ordered star-bearing types FIRST, every subtree rooted at a regular-only type explores regular-only types and nothing else — i.e. exactly this search. Measuring it prices what restricting the roots to star types would skip. Same regulars and closure as isotox-sub-10_12, star removed.
